# Results

## Cases over time

<!-- TASK 2: This chunk makes a figure. Give it a caption via fig-cap
     and a label starting with `fig-` so you can cross-reference it. -->

```{r}
#| label: fig-cases
#| fig-cap: "TODO: write a caption"

ggplot(cases, aes(month, n, colour = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Cases")
```

## Summary table

<!-- TASK 3: This chunk makes a table. -->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "TODO: write a caption"

cases |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n), mean = round(mean(n), 1))
```
